say:1:1230412001:1.text: How's Sinbad doing? It's been a while since I last met him.
say:1:1230412001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达还好吗？我有段时间没见过他了。
say:1:1230412001:1.male: How's Sinbad doing? It's been a while since I last met him.
say:1:1230412001:1.female: How's Sinbad doing? It's been a while since I last met him.

say:2:1230412002:1.text: He barely shares anything with us since he got older.
say:2:1230412002:1.source_cn: 虽然他长大之后，很多事情都不再和我们说。
say:2:1230412002:1.male: He barely shares anything with us since he got older.
say:2:1230412002:1.female: He barely shares anything with us since he got older.

say:3:1230412003:1.text: I still remember his scrawny and lonely figure when he was little. We felt sorry for him, so we all pitched in to buy food and make soup for him.
say:3:1230412003:1.source_cn: 我还记得他小时候孤苦伶仃，瘦瘦小小的，我们看他实在可怜...
say:3:1230412003:1.male: I still remember his scrawny and lonely figure when he was little. We felt sorry for him, so we all pitched in to buy food and make soup for him.
say:3:1230412003:1.female: I still remember his scrawny and lonely figure when he was little. We felt sorry for him, so we all pitched in to buy food and make soup for him.

say:4:1230412004:1.text: Now, he's a grown man already... Time really flies, huh?
say:4:1230412004:1.source_cn: 现在他长大啦……时间过得真快啊。
say:4:1230412004:1.male: Now, he's a grown man already... Time really flies, huh?
say:4:1230412004:1.female: Now, he's a grown man already... Time really flies, huh?
